k_rule: lowest combined rank of silhouette (higher better) and Davies-Bouldin (lower better) within the literature range 4-6; ties -> preferred k=5

clusters.name: Dormant / Just-in-time

clusters.name: Active Trader

clusters.name: Systematic Saver
